recommended_root_cursor.representation: 72raw bytes: uint64 offset big-endian8 + canonical full validated projection SHA25632 + HMAC-SHA25632; exact unpadded URL-safe Base64 length96, below max128.
recommended_root_cursor.label: history-evidence-page/1
recommended_root_cursor.binding: Canonical array of version label, GET, getTaskEvidence, /analysis/tasks/{id}/evidence, actor.user_id, actor.org_id, scope.case_id, key.task_id, key.run_version, key.result_version, effective limit.
recommended_root_cursor.scope: Cursor is a continuation position, not authority. Current route authentication, unified permission, case/object/source bindings and repository verification run on every request.
recommended_root_cursor.decode: Reuse cursor_encoding.decode_cursor(value,padded=False); reject noncanonical encoding, plus/slash alphabet, whitespace, extra padding/tail/nonzero padding bits, wrong length, bad MAC with422 PAGE_CURSOR_INVALID. Constant-time full32byteMAC compare.
recommended_root_cursor.snapshot: Hash all projected EvidencePage fields and item order, after existing projection/schema/binding validation; do not modify stored data. MAC must be checked before exposing a snapshot-stale distinction.
recommended_root_cursor.stale: Valid MAC with same task/run/result/limit/scope but changed projection digest ->409 PAGE_CURSOR_STALE. Cross actor/org/case/task/version/limit/endpoint ->422 PAGE_CURSOR_INVALID. Latest advancing versions may therefore yield422 under key-bound MAC; do not promise409 for that case.
recommended_root_cursor.offset: Offset paging is safe here because the full immutable projection digest binds every field and exact existing order. Validate 1<=offset<len(items); issued continuation positions are multiples of effective limit, encode only when more exists. No sortedUUID reordering required.
recommended_root_cursor.ordering: Preserve existing projection item order. EvidencePage contract has no ranked/sorted order definition; do not invent algorithm rank. Reject duplicate UUID identities case-insensitively before paging to avoid hiding broken snapshots across slices.
recommended_root_cursor.size_limit: uint64 position does not cap public run/result version integers; those remain JSON binding values. Existing snapshot materialization cost stays; this is HTTP payload pagination, not streaming SQL/memory scalability.
